item.title: Nimbo: Light-Filled Genoa Apartment Woven with Historic Detail Charm

item.title: Steinach 10 Reframes Attic Living With Color-Rich Belle Époque Details
item.description: Steinach 10 crowns a 19th-century building in Merano, Italy, where NAEMAS Architekturkonzepte reworks two attic apartments into bright, ornamented homes.
